7. RESCIND – SHARED TURN AND THROUGH LANE
ESTABLISH - THROUGH LANE EXCEPT MUNI
Hayes Street, westbound, between Van Ness Avenue and Franklin Street (Supervisor District 5)
(Approvable by the City Traffic Engineer) Edgar Orozco, [staff email removed — see the order]

Proposal to remove dual turn lanes to improve pedestrian safety.

Public Comments: Received two emails in support and one in opposition prior to public hearing.
Comment received during public hearing regarding No Left Turn off of Van Ness resulting in heavier
usage on Franklin. Consider signal phase separation instead of turn lane removal. Comment received
regarding analysis of resulting backup/queue potentially impacting Muni.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.
